title: Assembly of finite coefficient models on a finite stratification
statement: Let T be a topologically noetherian scheme, ℓ prime, and M an Ω_T-module, with Ω_T as in [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Let S be a finite scheme stratification of T as in [def-constructible-stratification]. Suppose for each stratum immersion s_a:S_a→T there are a finite coefficient field E_a [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set] and a locally finitely presented s_a⁻¹(E_a)_T-module N_a with (s_a⁻¹Ω_T)⊗_(s_a⁻¹(E_a)_T)N_a ≅ s_a⁻¹M. Then there are a finite coefficient field E and a constructible E_T-module N with Ω_T⊗_(E_T)N ≅ M. No common coefficient field for the strata is assumed.

proof.text: Perform well-founded induction on the closed subsets D of T, with the assertion that every closed immersion Y→T with image contained in D admits a finite coefficient model for the pullback of M. At each D apply the one-step support lemma to the induction hypothesis on every D' < D. Finally specialize to D = top and the identity immersion of T and compose with the canonical identity comparison for condensed upper-star.

theorem exists_finiteCoefficient_model_of_stratum_models
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace T]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ))
    (S : Scheme.Stratification T)
    (hS : ∀ a : Fin S.n,
      ∃ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ))
        (M_E : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (S.domain a)) Ab.{u + 1})
          ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (S.immersion a)).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E))),
        IsLocallyFinitelyPresented
          ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (S.immersion a)).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E)) M_E ∧
        Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (S.immersion a)).map
          (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl T ℓ E))).obj M_E ≅
            (((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (S.immersion a)).mapMod
              (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ)).obj M))) :
    ∃ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ))
      (M_E : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E)),
      IsConstructibleModuleObject (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E) M_E ∧
        Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl T ℓ E)).obj M_E ≅ M)
